name: codex-review-mcp
description: Have ChatGPT review Claude's drafts as your editor, using your own ChatGPT subscription through the Codex CLI.
long_description: Adds ChatGPT review to Claude. chatgpt_review sends a document to ChatGPT, which reviews it with your editor instructions file if you set one and ends with VERDICT: READY or VERDICT: REVISE. The Write a paper prompt runs the whole loop: Claude drafts, ChatGPT edits, Claude revises, up to two rounds. Long reviews come back as a job ID that chatgpt_result collects, so they don't time out. chatgpt_check tests the setup. Requests run through the OpenAI Codex CLI in a read-only sandbox on your ChatGPT plan; no API key is needed. Document text is sent to OpenAI.

tools.name: chatgpt_review
tools.description: Send a document to ChatGPT for review, using your editor instructions if set.

tools.name: chatgpt_ask
tools.description: Ask ChatGPT a question, optionally with context.

tools.name: chatgpt_result
tools.description: Collect a long-running review or answer by its job ID.

tools.name: chatgpt_check
tools.description: Check that Codex is installed, signed in and can answer.

instructions_file.title: Editor instructions file (recommended)
instructions_file.description: A text or Markdown file with your ChatGPT editor instructions, for example your editor skill. ChatGPT reviews as that editor. Leave blank to use the built-in reviewer.

effort.title: Reasoning effort
effort.description: How hard ChatGPT thinks: low, medium (default), high or xhigh. Higher is slower. Type default to use your Codex setting.

codex_path.title: Codex executable (optional)
codex_path.description: Leave blank to auto-detect. Set this if Claude can't find codex (for example C:\Users\you\AppData\Local\Programs\OpenAI\Codex\bin\codex.exe or /opt/homebrew/bin/codex).

timeout_ms.title: Timeout (ms)
timeout_ms.description: How long one review may run before it's stopped.

model.title: Model (optional)
model.description: Override the Codex model. Leave blank for your Codex default.
